notes: Feature variants are optional alternatives; use one feature graphic per listing.
Original native captures and app-only crops are provenance/support files, not additional phone uploads.
Controlled fixtures are native app renders with deterministic position/hazard state; no altered scores, fabricated effects or stitched gameplay.
Assets avoid blood, corpses and death effects. Content-rating disclosures must still accurately describe the game's violence.
No ads, leaderboards, monetization, awards, pricing or store-badge claims are depicted.
